business_summary: Hangzhou Huawang New Material Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in research and development, production, and sales of decorative base papers. It also engages in the wood pulp trade; thermal energy; and import, export business. The company was formerly known as Hangzhou Huatian Paper Co. Ltd. Hangzhou Huawang New Material Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: 항저우 화왕신소재기술유한회사 장식원지의 연구개발, 생산, 판매업을 영위하고 있습니다. 또한 목재 펄프 무역에도 종사하고 있습니다. 열에너지; 및 수입, 수출 사업. 회사의 이전 명칭은 Hangzhou Huatian Paper Co. Ltd. Hangzhou Huawang New Material Technology Co.,Ltd. 1994년에 설립되었으며 중국 항저우에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
